emutils.name: EMUtils
emutils.hub.feature.chat.desc: Copy, timestamp, filter, and highlight chat.
emutils.hub.feature.waypoints.desc: Save and manage death and custom waypoints.
emutils.hub.feature.auto_reconnect.desc: Reconnect after kicks with retry controls.
emutils.hub.feature.screenshot.desc: Quick screenshot actions and clipboard helpers.
emutils.hub.feature.screenshot_gallery.d: Browse, copy, open, and delete screenshots.
emutils.hub.feature.pack_manager.desc: Browse, download, and apply resource packs.
emutils.hub.feature.script_manager.desc: Create, run, and keybind Minescript scripts.
emutils.hub.feature.hud.desc: Configure the info overlay and layout editor.
emutils.hub.feature.food_hud.desc: Food values on the vanilla hunger bar.
emutils.hub.feature.spotify.desc: Pause menu and HUD now-playing controls.
emutils.hub.feature.inventory.desc: Slot locking, sorting, quick stack, search and more.
emutils.hub.feature.fullbright.desc: Brighten dark areas without changing gamma.
emutils.hub.feature.clear_weather.desc: Choose which weather effects are hidden.
emutils.hub.feature.no_fire_overlay.desc: Hide the first-person fire overlay while burning.
emutils.hub.feature.low_fire_overlay.des: Keep flames visible but lower on screen.
emutils.hub.feature.no_nausea.desc: Hide nausea and portal distortion effects.
emutils.hub.feature.no_pumpkin_overlay.d: Hide the carved pumpkin blur while wearing one.
emutils.hub.feature.fast_use.desc: Remove the delay between item uses and block interactions.
emutils.hub.feature.anti_durability_brea: Stop held items from being used before they break, and warn when they get low.
emutils.hub.feature.auto_tool.desc: Automatically use the fastest suitable tool for the block you are mining.
emutils.hub.feature.auto_flight.desc: Equip flight gear while falling and restore your previous items after landing.
emutils.hub.feature.safe_walk.desc: Prevent walking off ledges without slowing down.
emutils.hub.feature.place_below.desc: Hold its keybind to place beneath the block you target.
emutils.hub.feature.locked_y_placement.d: Only place blocks at the locked Y level.
emutils.hub.feature.free_camera.desc: Detach the camera while your player remains frozen in place.
Hide ambient Nether particles such as Basalt Deltas ash.
emutils.hub.feature.no_falling_leaf_part: Hide leaf particles drifting down from leaves, including cherry, pale oak and poplar.
emutils.hub.feature.beacon_radius.desc: Draw a chunk-border-style grid around loaded active beacon ranges.
emutils.hub.feature.own_nametag.desc: Show your own nametag in third person.

emutils.option.screenshot_auto_copy.desc: Copy each new screenshot to the clipboard, where supported.
emutils.option.screenshot_metadata.desc: Save where each screenshot was taken, such as the position, server and dimension.
emutils.option.screenshot_sort.desc: How screenshots are ordered in the gallery.
emutils.option.screenshot_max_count.desc: How many recent screenshots the gallery shows.
emutils.option.chat_features.desc: Turn every chat feature below on or off at once.
emutils.option.copy_chat.desc: Ctrl + left click a chat message to copy it.
emutils.option.copy_chat_formatting.desc: Keep colors and formatting in copied messages.
emutils.option.copy_chat_feedback.desc: Show a short confirmation after copying.
emutils.option.chat_timestamps.desc: Show the time before each chat message.
emutils.option.chat_timestamp_24_hour.de: Use 24-hour time for timestamps and the HUD clock.
emutils.option.smart_chat_filters.desc: Collapse repeated messages into one line with a counter.
emutils.option.duplicate_message_time_wi: Only group repeats that arrive close together.
How close together repeats must be to get grouped.
emutils.option.chat_mention_alerts.desc: Play a sound when someone mentions your name.
emutils.option.chat_mention_highlight.de: Highlight your name in chat messages.
emutils.option.chat_mention_highlight_co: The color your name is highlighted in.
emutils.option.chat_mention_highlight_st: How your highlighted name is styled.
emutils.option.chat_mention_alert_volume: How loud the mention sound is.
Which sound plays when you are mentioned.
emutils.option.waypoint_auto_copy.desc: Copy the coordinates when a waypoint is created.
emutils.option.copy_coordinates_feedback: Show a chat message when the Copy Coordinates key copies your position.
emutils.option.waypoint_default_death_co: The color of new death waypoints.
emutils.option.waypoint_default_custom_c: The color of new custom waypoints.
emutils.option.retry_delay.desc: How long to wait before reconnecting.
emutils.option.waypoint_opacity.desc: How see-through waypoint markers and labels are in the world.
emutils.option.waypoint_size.desc: How large waypoint markers are in the world.
emutils.option.waypoint_font.desc: The font of waypoint names, distances and initials. Minecraft's font is the game's own; the EMUtils font matches the menus.
emutils.option.waypoint_label_background: How dark the panel behind a waypoint's name and distance is. At 0% there is no panel.
emutils.option.waypoint_edge_pin.desc: Keep waypoints that are off-screen or behind you at the edge of the screen, pointing the way to them.
emutils.option.waypoint_max_distance.des: Hide waypoints farther away than this. They fade out over the last stretch.
emutils.option.hud_show_icons.desc: Show an icon beside each value.
emutils.option.hud_hide_with_debug.desc: Hide the overlay while the F3 debug screen is open.
emutils.hud.layout_editor.hint: Drag to move. Hold Ctrl to snap. Drag the top-right corner to resize. Right-click an element to reset its size.
emutils.option.hud_coordinates.desc: Your X, Y and Z position.
emutils.option.hud_nether_coordinates.de: The matching Nether position while in the Overworld.
emutils.option.hud_chunk_region.desc: The chunk and region you are in.
emutils.option.hud_biome.desc: The biome you are standing in.
emutils.option.hud_ping.desc: Your connection's latency to the server.
emutils.option.hud_speed.desc: How fast you are moving, in blocks per second.
emutils.option.hud_day_night.desc: Real time left until night (when monsters start spawning) or until day.
emutils.option.hud_slime_chunk.desc: Whether you stand in a slime chunk. Needs the world seed, so singleplayer only.
emutils.option.hud_target_block.desc: Coordinates of the block you are looking at.
emutils.option.hud_tps.desc: Server ticks per second. Exact in singleplayer, with the milliseconds a tick takes; estimated from time updates on servers (shown with ~).
emutils.option.hud_tps_colors.desc: Green while the server keeps up, amber when it runs slow, red when it lags badly.
emutils.option.hud_tps_compact.desc: Show only the TPS, without the milliseconds per tick.
emutils.option.hud_hide_in_containers.de: Hide the overlay while a chest, your inventory or another container is open.
emutils.option.hud_text_shadow.desc: A shadow under the text and icons. Auto adds it when the background is below 50% opacity.
emutils.option.hud_memory.desc: How much memory the game is using.
emutils.option.food_hud_saturation_overl: Show hidden saturation on the hunger bar.
emutils.option.food_hud_held_food_overla: Preview how much the food in your hand restores.
Preview food held in your offhand too.
emutils.option.food_hud_exhaustion_under: Show exhaustion building up under the hunger bar.
emutils.option.food_hud_tooltips.desc: Show food and saturation values in item tooltips.
emutils.option.food_hud_vanilla_animatio: Shake the overlays with the hunger bar like vanilla does.
emutils.option.zoom_cinematic_camera.des: Smooth out mouse movement while zoomed.
emutils.option.zoom_hide_hand.desc: Hide the held item while zoomed.
emutils.option.zoom_smooth_transition.de: Ease into zoom instead of snapping.
emutils.option.zoom_hide_hud.desc: Hide the whole HUD while zoomed, like pressing F1.
emutils.option.zoom_out_speed.desc: How quickly zoom eases back out.
emutils.option.tweak_fullbright_strength: How strongly dark areas are brightened.
emutils.option.tweak_no_fog.desc: Push distance fog back where possible.
emutils.option.tweak_no_nether_particles: Hide ambient Nether particles like Basalt Deltas ash.
emutils.ui.nothing_to_set_up: Nothing else to set up. Flip the switch and you're done.
emutils.ui.loading.shader_note: Compiling shaders can take a few seconds.
emutils.ui.pack.off: Pack Manager is turned off. Turn it on with its switch in the settings.
emutils.ui.script.pick: Pick a script to edit, or make a new one.
emutils.ui.script.keybind_moves: %s uses these keys now. Saving moves them to this script.
emutils.ui.hud_editor.title: HUD Layout
emutils.ui.hud_editor.hint: Drag to move · Hold Ctrl to snap · Arrow keys nudge
emutils.ui.mass_drop.search: Search items to add, by name or ID
emutils.ui.mass_drop.legit_desc: Legit drops one matching stack per press.
emutils.ui.mass_drop.unfair_desc: Unfair drops every matching stack at once.
emutils.ui.mass_drop.empty: Nothing gets dropped yet. Search for items above to add them.
emutils.ui.shortcut.needs_world: Join a world to run shortcuts
emutils.ui.shortcut.name: Name
emutils.ui.shortcut.text_hint: Start with / to run a command.
emutils.ui.shortcut.keys_hint: Works while playing, not while a screen is open.
emutils.ui.shortcut.empty: No shortcuts yet. Add one to run a command or send a chat message with a key.
emutils.ui.shortcut.clear_message: Delete all %s shortcuts? This can’t be undone.
emutils.ui.shortcut.clear_message_one: Delete the shortcut? This can’t be undone.
emutils.ui.script.error.go_to: Click to go to the line
emutils.ui.script.rename.title: Rename or move
emutils.ui.script.rename.message: Change the name, or the folder path to move it. Its keybind comes along.
emutils.ui.script.rename.folder_message: Change the name, or the path to move it. Keybinds of the scripts inside come along.
emutils.ui.script.new_folder.message: Name the folder. Use / to put it inside another folder.
emutils.ui.script.delete_folder.title: Delete folder?
emutils.ui.script.delete_folder.message: Delete %s and the %s scripts in it? This can’t be undone.
emutils.ui.script.delete_folder.message_: Delete %s and the script in it? This can’t be undone.
emutils.ui.script.python.not_working: Minescript can't start Python, so scripts won't run.
emutils.ui.script.python.not_set: Minescript has no Python set, so scripts won't run.
emutils.ui.script.python.too_old: Minescript needs Python 3.8 or newer, but this is Python %s.
emutils.ui.script.python.none_found: No working Python found. Install Python 3, then refresh.
emutils.ui.waypoint.name: Name
emutils.ui.waypoint.beacon.desc: A beam of light that shows the way from far off.
emutils.ui.waypoint.needs_world: Join a world to add waypoints.
emutils.ui.waypoint.no_world: Waypoints belong to a world. Join a world or server to see and add them.
emutils.ui.waypoint.turned_off: Turn on Waypoints to add them.
emutils.ui.waypoint.save_failed: Couldn't save the waypoint. See the log.
emutils.ui.waypoint.clear_message: This deletes all %s waypoints in this world and dimension. It can't be undone.
emutils.ui.waypoint.clear_message_one: This deletes the %s waypoint in this world and dimension. It can't be undone.
emutils.option.tweak_no_falling_leaf_par: Hide leaves drifting down from trees.
emutils.option.tweak_no_hurt_cam.desc: Stop the camera shaking when you take damage.
emutils.option.tweak_freelook.desc: Look around while holding the key without changing where you walk.
emutils.option.freelook_keep_perspective: Look around in the perspective you are in, first person too, instead of switching to third person.
Show cached MiniHUD-style block light numbers and spawn-risk markers on nearby floors.
emutils.option.tweak_shulker_tooltip_pre: Show shulker box contents in its tooltip.
emutils.option.tweak_bundle_tooltip_prev: Show bundle contents in its tooltip.
emutils.option.tweak_clear_weather_hide_: Remove rain splashes and rain sounds too.
Stop the sky and world from flashing bright when lightning strikes. Thunder still sounds.
Don't draw lightning bolts. They still strike, set fires and deal damage.
emutils.option.tweak_no_fire_overlay.des: Hide the flames on your screen while burning.
emutils.option.tweak_low_fire_overlay.de: Keep the flames but lower them out of the way.
emutils.option.tweak_no_nausea.desc: Remove the screen warping from nausea and portals.
emutils.option.tweak_no_spyglass_overlay: Remove the dark ring around the spyglass view.
emutils.option.tweak_hide_effects.desc: Hide the vanilla status effect display. Effects still work; only the icons and list go away.
emutils.option.tweak_hide_effects_hud.de: Hide the effect icons in the top-right corner of the screen.
emutils.option.tweak_hide_effects_invent: Hide the effect list next to your survival and creative inventory.
emutils.hub.feature.hide_effects.desc: Hide the vanilla effect icons on the HUD and beside the inventory.
Remove the pumpkin view blur while wearing one.
emutils.option.tweak_fast_place.desc: Remove the delay between placing blocks.
emutils.option.tweak_fast_use.desc: Remove the delay between using items like doors, buttons and snowballs.
emutils.option.tweak_anti_durability_bre: Stop using a tool when it is about to break.
emutils.option.anti_durability_unit.desc: Whether Protect At and Warn At count durability points left or percent of the item's maximum.
emutils.option.anti_durability_protect_a: Held items with this much durability left or less can't attack, break blocks or be used.
emutils.option.anti_durability_warning.d: Show a message above the hotbar and play a sound when a held item gets low.
emutils.option.anti_durability_warn_at.d: How much durability left counts as low for the warning.
emutils.option.auto_tool_mode.desc: Legit only uses your hotbar. Unfair searches your whole inventory.
emutils.option.auto_tool_fortune.desc: Prefer the tool with the highest Fortune on ores, glowstone, sea lanterns, melons and amethyst clusters.
emutils.option.auto_tool_silk_touch.desc: Prefer a Silk Touch tool on blocks it keeps whole, such as ores, glass, ice, bookshelves and ender chests.
emutils.option.auto_tool_efficiency.desc: Prefer the fastest tool, Efficiency included.
emutils.option.auto_tool_return_to_previ: Switch back to what you were holding when you stop mining.
emutils.option.tweak_safe_walk.desc: Stop at block edges without sneaking. Jumping still lets you leave an edge.
emutils.option.tweak_free_camera.desc: Fly the camera around while your player stays put.
emutils.option.free_camera_hud_mode.desc: Show a clean view or your normal HUD while the camera is detached.
emutils.option.free_camera_boost_multipl: How much faster the camera moves while sprinting.
emutils.option.free_camera_horizontal_sp: How fast the camera moves forward, back and sideways.
emutils.option.free_camera_vertical_spee: How fast the camera moves up with jump and down with sneak.
emutils.option.free_camera_collision.des: Stop the camera at blocks instead of passing through them.
emutils.option.free_camera_double_tap.de: Start Free Camera with a double tap of its key, so a stray press doesn't detach the camera. One press still ends it.
emutils.option.free_camera_custom_fov.de: Use a field of view of its own while the camera is detached.
emutils.option.free_camera_fov.desc: The detached camera's field of view, with Camera FOV on.
Put on an elytra from your inventory when you start falling.
emutils.option.tweak_auto_switch_rockets: Move rockets into a hotbar slot when you start falling.
emutils.option.auto_switch_rockets_hotba: The hotbar slot rockets are moved into.
emutils.option.auto_flight_ignore_short_: Wait until there is no block below you in reach before switching gear.
emutils.option.auto_flight_double_jump.d: Double-tap jump to equip the elytra and glide right away, instead of waiting for a fall.
emutils.option.tweak_own_nametag.desc: Show your own nametag in third person.
emutils.option.pack_manager_replace_reso: Minecraft's Resource Packs button in Options opens the Pack Manager. Shift-click it for Minecraft's own screen.
emutils.option.custom_capes.desc: Show capes from other cape mods. For each player, the first source in the list below that has a cape for them wins.
emutils.option.cape.minecraft.desc: Official Minecraft capes. Placed above a provider, a player's official cape wins over that provider's; off hides them.
emutils.capes.hint: Choose which third-party cape providers EMUtils is allowed to use. Preferred Provider picks your own cape when you have more than one, and prioritizes that provider for everyone else.
emutils.option.spotify.desc: Turn both Spotify players below on or off at once.
emutils.option.spotify_player.desc: Show now-playing controls in the pause menu.
emutils.option.spotify_hud_overlay.desc: Show the now-playing panel while you play.
emutils.option.spotify_player_scroll_tit: Scroll through titles too long for the pause menu player, like Spotify does.
emutils.option.spotify_hud_scroll_titles: Scroll through titles too long for the HUD overlay, like Spotify does.
emutils.option.slot_locking.desc: Lock inventory slots so their items can't be moved or dropped. Saved per world or server.
emutils.option.slot_binding.desc: Bind an inventory slot to a hotbar slot to swap them safely.
emutils.option.slot_lock_color.desc: The overlay color on locked slots.
emutils.option.bound_slot_color.desc: The overlay color on bound slots.
emutils.option.slot_binding_lock_bound_s: Protect bound slots from being moved by accident.
emutils.option.hover_transfer.desc: Shift + left click in a container, then hover items to move them.
emutils.option.hover_transfer_global.des: Allow hover transfer in your own inventory and similar screens too.
emutils.option.sort_buttons.desc: Show buttons beside containers to sort by name, category or quantity.
emutils.option.sort_speed.desc: Legit spaces the clicks out like a player would.
emutils.option.inventory_search.desc: A search box above chests, shulker boxes and your inventory. Items whose name, ID or lore match are outlined. Ctrl+F jumps to it.
emutils.option.inventory_search_dim.desc: Darken the items that do not match while you search.
emutils.option.inventory_search_shulkers: A shulker box with a match inside is outlined too, with a filled corner, and its preview shows which items match.
emutils.option.inventory_search_remember: Keep what you typed for the next container, so you can look through chest after chest.
emutils.option.inventory_search_creative: Also show the search box in the creative inventory. It only looks at your own inventory, not the item tabs, which have their own search.
emutils.option.quick_stack.desc: Move items into a container that already holds the same items.
emutils.option.quick_stack_speed.desc: Legit adds a short, varied delay between stacks.
emutils.option.auto_refill.desc: Refill your hand from your inventory when a block stack runs out.
emutils.inventory.sort.name: Sort by Name
emutils.option.inventory_preview.desc: Show a small preview of your inventory above the hotbar.
emutils.option.preserve_container_cursor: Keep the mouse in place when switching between container screens.
emutils.mass_drop.title: Mass Drop
emutils.spotify.player.title: Now Playing
emutils.spotify.player.hint: Pause Menu Player shows controls at the bottom of the pause menu. In-Game HUD Overlay shows the same now playing panel in the bottom-right while playing. Linux requires playerctl; macOS and Windows use the desktop Spotify app media session.
emutils.hub.feature.look_at_info.desc: Details about the block or mob in your crosshair.
emutils.option.look_at_info.desc: A card with the name, ID and details of the block or entity you are looking at, within reach.
emutils.option.look_at_info_blocks.desc: Show the card while you look at a block.
emutils.option.look_at_info_entities.des: Show the card while you look at a mob, player or other entity.
emutils.option.look_at_info_show_id.desc: The ID under the name, such as minecraft:stone.
emutils.option.look_at_info_hardness.des: How hard the block is to break, or Unbreakable for blocks like bedrock.
emutils.option.look_at_info_break_time.d: How long breaking it takes with what you hold, counting enchantments, effects and standing in water.
emutils.option.look_at_info_tool.desc: The tool that mines it fastest, and the lowest tier that gets drops when it needs one.
emutils.option.look_at_info_harvest.desc: For blocks that need a certain tool, like stone and ores: whether what you hold gets drops from it, in green or red.
emutils.option.look_at_info_health.desc: Health, max health and absorption, colored by how hurt it is.
emutils.option.look_at_info_armor.desc: Armor points, when it has any.
emutils.option.look_at_info_effects.desc: Active effects with their level and time left. Servers only share your own effects, so other mobs' show in singleplayer.
emutils.hub.feature.armor_status.desc: Your armor and held items with their durability, warning when it runs low.
emutils.option.armor_status.desc: Show your armor and held items with how much durability they have left.
emutils.option.armor_status_helmet.desc: Show the helmet, or whatever you wear on your head.
emutils.option.armor_status_main_hand.de: Show the held item. Blocks and other stackables show how many you carry.
emutils.option.armor_status_off_hand.des: Show the item in your off hand, such as a shield or totem.
emutils.option.armor_status_fireworks.de: While wearing an elytra, show how many firework rockets you carry.
emutils.option.armor_status_hide_in_cont: Hide the card while a chest, your inventory or another container is open.
emutils.option.armor_status_display.desc: Write durability as what's left, what's left out of the maximum, or a percentage.
emutils.option.armor_status_bar.desc: Show a durability bar under each item's durability.
Items with this much durability left or less turn the warning color.
emutils.option.armor_status_flash.desc: Low items fade in and out, so they catch your eye.
emutils.option.armor_status_sound.desc: Play a sound when an item drops to Low Durability. Held items are left to Anti-Durability Break's warning while that's on.
emutils.hub.feature.scoreboard.desc: The server's sidebar scoreboard as a HUD element you can move, resize and restyle.
emutils.option.scoreboard.desc: Take over the sidebar scoreboard. It shows what the server sends, but you place it in the HUD Layout Editor. With this off, the vanilla scoreboard shows.
emutils.option.scoreboard_style.desc: A card in the settings look, or the dark bars vanilla draws behind the sidebar.
emutils.option.scoreboard_font.desc: Minecraft's font keeps every server color and style exactly. The EMUtils font keeps colors and bold, but not italics or obfuscated text.
emutils.option.scoreboard_show_numbers.d: Show the scores on the right, the red numbers. Servers can hide them too.
emutils.option.scoreboard_title_alignmen: Center the title above the lines, or line it up with their left edge.
emutils.scoreboard.sample.title: Scoreboard
emutils.hub.feature.tab_list.desc: The player list you hold Tab for, as a HUD element with ping numbers, sorting and layout options.
emutils.option.tab_list.desc: Take over the player list you hold Tab for. It shows the same players, header and footer as vanilla. With this off, the vanilla list shows.
emutils.option.tab_list_style.desc: A card in the settings look, or the dark bars vanilla draws behind the list.
emutils.option.tab_list_font.desc: Minecraft's font keeps every server color and style exactly. The EMUtils font keeps colors and bold, but not italics or obfuscated text.
emutils.option.tab_list_heads.desc: Show each player's head. Like vanilla, not on offline-mode servers, where skins can't be trusted.
emutils.option.tab_list_highlight_self.d: Mark your own row in the menu accent color.
emutils.option.tab_list_animation.desc: Fade and slide the list in when you press Tab and out when you let go. It follows the Animations speed in the menu settings.
emutils.option.tab_list_centered.desc: Keep the list in the middle of the screen however wide it gets, like vanilla. Only its height is placed in the HUD Layout Editor. Turn off to place it anywhere.
emutils.option.tab_list_sort.desc: Vanilla puts the server's order first, spectators last, then team and name. Or sort by name, or by lowest ping.
emutils.option.tab_list_sort.name: Name
emutils.option.tab_list_columns.desc: The most columns the list may use. Auto adds columns like vanilla does, so no column is longer than 20 players.
emutils.option.tab_list_row_height.desc: How tall each player's row is. Vanilla's is 9.
emutils.option.tab_list_ping.desc: Show ping as vanilla's connection bars, as a number in milliseconds, or both.
emutils.option.tab_list_ping_colors.desc: Color the ping number green, amber or red by how high it is.
emutils.tab_list.sample.footer: Sample players show until the server lists more
emutils.hub.feature.keystrokes.desc: Your movement keys and clicks per second on screen.
emutils.option.keystrokes.desc: Show your movement keys, lighting up while held. Each key shows what it is bound to.
emutils.option.keystrokes_mouse.desc: Show the attack and use buttons under the movement keys.
emutils.option.keystrokes_cps.desc: Show how many times each mouse button was clicked in the last second.
emutils.option.keystrokes_space.desc: Show the jump key as a bar under the other keys.
emutils.option.keystrokes_sneak.desc: Show the sneak key at the bottom.
emutils.option.keystrokes_style.desc: Rounded keys like the menus, or squarer ones.
emutils.option.keystrokes_menu_accent.de: Held keys light up in the menus' accent color. Turn it off to pick a color below.
The color held keys light up in.
emutils.option.keystrokes_hide_in_contai: Hide the keys while a chest, your inventory or another container is open.
emutils.chat.mention.toast.title: You were mentioned
emutils.gallery.delete.title: Delete Screenshot?
emutils.death_waypoint.prompt: You are near a death location.
emutils.death_waypoint.cleared_world: Cleared death waypoints for this world.
emutils.death_waypoint.none_world: No death waypoints for this world.
emutils.option.beacon_radius_range.desc: How far away beacons get an outline. Never further than your render distance.
emutils.option.beacon_radius_active_only: Only outline beacons that give an effect, not ones where no effect has been picked yet.
emutils.option.beacon_radius_grid_spacin: How many blocks apart the grid lines are. Smaller means a tighter grid.
How thick the grid lines are. The cage's edges are drawn a bit thicker.
emutils.option.light_level_range.desc: How many blocks around you are checked. A smaller range is lighter on performance.
emutils.option.light_level_spawnable_onl: Only mark spots at block light 0, where hostile mobs can spawn.
emutils.pack.delete.title: Delete Pack?
emutils.pack.delete.message: Delete %s from disk? This cannot be undone.
emutils.script_manager.empty: No scripts found. Create one to get started.
emutils.script_manager.create_hint: Path under minecraft/minescript; .py is added if missing.
emutils.script_manager.read_only: This script type is read-only in EMUtils.
emutils.script_manager.unsafe_command: This filename cannot be run safely. Rename it first.
emutils.script_manager.capture_key: Press a key combination, or Esc to cancel.
emutils.script_manager.keybind_hint: Press the key combination you want, then click Save.
emutils.script_manager.duplicate_message: That keybind is already assigned to %s.
